verdicts.decision_note: The client introduces the executable rule that additional Small Block tickets increase an affiliate's probability of winning.
The client defines Small Block ticket issuance, current-block eligibility, post-draw reset, non-carryover, and exclusion of secondary-sale ticket generation.
The payload concerns secondary-sale state transfer, wallet access, and no-referral recipient allocation, which belong to narrower existing Requirements rather than the Small Block ticket lifecycle.
Removing Big Blocks makes the existing Small-versus-Big counter-independence attribute obsolete; the removed key was established by message 21.
First concrete verification that a successful referral-code mint issued a ticket to the referred NFT.
The client establishes the system acceptance invariant of one Small Block ticket per primary mint while excluding secondary-market sales.
The proposed backfill concerns ticket counts reflected in leaderboard and NFT attributes, so it belongs to REQ_TICKET_ACCOUNTING_VISIBILITY rather than this Requirement.
The client unambiguously accepts the proposed system rule that Mint #1 is the sole exception because no earlier NFT exists to receive its ticket.
